sloka: स्वर्णकुम्भनिभौ पीनौ शुभौ भीरु निरन्तरौ ।कस्योरस्थलसंस्पर्शं दास्यतस्ते कुचाविमौ ।। ७.२६.२३ ॥
transliteration: svarṇakumbhanibhau pīnau śubhau bhīru nirantarau ।kasyorasthalasaṁsparśaṁ dāsyataste kucāvimau ।। 7.26.23 ॥

translations.english: O timid one, whose chest will these two plump, beautiful, close-set breasts of yours, resembling golden pitchers, touch?
